events.event: Annual reporting documents 589 investigations resulting in remediation, alongside 2,420 in-depth investigations. No individual misconduct adjudication or criminal finding is implied.

methodology: 2024 versus 2023: appeals 4,229 vs 4,960; investigations 2,420 vs 2,374. 589 remediation cases are a subset of 2,420 investigations, not 4,229 appeals. Labour disruption and changes in referral pathways limit trend interpretation. Do not infer causal trust effects, guilt or systemwide delivery failure. Publication day not established, hence event uses year precision.
